Malti Devi vs Ut Of J&K & Ors on 13 December, 2024 
Author: Rahul Bharti
Bench: Rahul Bharti
 Serial No. 77
 High Court Of Jammu & Kashmir And Ladakh
 At Jammu
Case:- Hcp No. 150/2024
 Cm No. 7160/2024
Malti Devi .....Appellant(s)/Petitioner(s)
 Through: Mr. Sanchit Verma, Advocate.
 Vs
Ut of J&K & Ors.
 ..... Respondent(s)
 Through: Mrs. Monika Kohli, Sr. Aag. 
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rahul Bharti, Judge
 Order 
(13.12.2024) 
01. Respondent No. 3 - SHO Police Station Bahu Fort, Jammu, namely, Rajesh Jasrotia and respondent No. 4 - Vidhi Dubey, Chairperson, Child Welfare Committee (CWC), Jammu are present in person pursuant to the direction of this Court. 
02. This Court has examined respondent No. 4 - Vidhi Dubey, Chairperson, Child Welfare Committee (CWC), Jammu to have assessment of the circumstances under which Aarti Devi alongwith her two minor children, one of whom being one month old, are in the care and custody of Shelter Home - Pareesha being run and managed by the Child Welfare Committee (CWC), Jammu. 
03. The respondent No. 4 - Vidhi Dubey, Chairperson, Child Welfare Committee (CWC), Jammu has assured this Court that subject to final orders of this Court so long as Aarti Devi alongwith her two children are in the Shelter Home - Pareesha each and every need of theirs is being met without subjecting them to any deprivation and denial and, therefore, the care and custody of Shelter Home - Pareesha is not adverse to the interest of Aarti Devi and her two children. This Court is satisfied Malti Devi vs Ut Of J&K & Ors on 13 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/62004871/
1 that Shelter Home - Pareesha for the time being is the best place for the three persons i.e. the Aarti and her two children to be there till the disposal of this petition. 
04. Issue notice to the respondents.
05. Mrs. Monika Kohli learned Senior AAG accepts notice on behalf of respondents to file response to the petition within a period of two weeks. 
06. It is directed that Shelter Home - Pareesha shall allow no access either to the petitioner - Malti Devi or to Rinku Devi in their purported claim as being mother-in-law and mother of Aarti Devi. 
Any act of interference on the part of the above-named two women or their representatives/agents meant to scare the administration of Shelter Home - Pareesha shall be seriously dealt with by lodging a report to Senior Superintendent of Police (SSP), Jammu who shall then be duty bound to ensure full protection of the Shelter Home - Pareesha for the sake of safety and security of not only the staff but also of Aarti Devi and her two children.
07. Director Social Welfare, Jammu is also directed to ensure that all the needs and necessities of Aarti Devi and of her two children are fully met without putting any call to the petitioner - Malti Devi or for that matter Rinku Devi asking for supply of winter clothing and food items. 
08. List in continuation on 30.12.2024.
09. A copy of this order be provided by the Registrar Judicial, Jammu to Mrs. Monika Kohli, learned Senior AAG for notice and for record sake. 
(RAHUL BHARTI) JUDGE JAMMU 13.12.2024 Bunty Malti Devi vs Ut Of J&K & Ors on 13 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/62004871/
2
